name: Myalgia
overview: Myalgia is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include painful sensations in muscle tissue. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.

In routine practice, the most common cause of acute myalgia is the overuse of a muscle or group of muscles.
Health professionals note that another likely cause is viral infection, especially when there has been no injury.
